from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-443138b4.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = []\n    for tile_y in range(3):\n        for y in range(h):\n            sy = h - 1 - y if tile_y % 2 == 0 else y\n            row = []\n            for tile_x in range(2):\n                part = grid[sy][::-1] if tile_x % 2 == 0 else grid[sy]\n                row.extend(part)\n            out.append(row)\n    return out\n''')
